name: YouTube
description: Music search, playlists (community and featured) and lyrics through YouTube Music, songs played and downloaded as YouTube's own audio files (its embedded player when those aren't given), and videos and live streams in Search's YouTube pill. No key needed; add your own YouTube Data API key to use the official API for music instead.
author: Raygun

settings.label: YouTube Data API key (optional: uses the official API instead of YouTube Music search)
Region for results (country code, e.g. US)
